text: Pelulu
Masked Man
Return to Underwater Ruins
Adaro
High Difficulty Hunting Event
Cannot go to another map during the battle!
BOSS BATTLE\nDefeat Adaro!!
So the treasure is behind the monster...\nThat's annoying, why does it have to be there...!
I don't think you'll understand even if I tell you\nto let me through...
Seems that they're ahead of me, but I haven't run\nout of luck yet. I'll take the chance to go inside\nwhile they get distracted by the monster...
Alright, it's time for you to show your skill!\nFinish it!
Huh?!
Oh, no no!! What was that?!
Oh? Since when were you here?
Darn it!\nWhy do I always end up getting this kind of role?!\nI hate it, whoaa!!
Here we go again...\nWhat a tough life you have...
Okay, while the monster is targeting him,\nI'll take the chance to grab the treasure...
Oh gosh, that was dangerous!!\nCan't you just lure it properly?!
Shut up!!
That guy is hopeless! Hey, just go and finish it!
Treasureee~!
Whaaat?!\nAre you guys just giving up?\nI'll keep going, I'm not gonna give up!!
Hey, just give up and wake up!!\nThis place is collapsing! Can't you see that?!
Hey! You can't make me give up\nthe treasure just because of this!\nPut me down! I said put me downnn!!
